risk.risk: Recovered PRs or the local specification baseline are absent from the implementation trunk
risk.impact: New worktrees lack inputs or reuse unreviewed security changes
risk.mitigation: M1-T1 includes the reviewed local spec in its first PR; later tasks start from the landed main. Recheck recovered PR head, checks and required approval individually; never merge or deploy automatically.
risk.trigger: The spec is absent from origin/main or a reused PR lacks current evidence or required security approval
